category_name: To the debtor when his debt is settled
title: To the debtor when his debt is settled - Hisn al-Muslim 91
arabic: بارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِك
transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik
translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).
